rule_yaml:
rules:
  - id: dubbo-npe-c1-merged
    languages:
      - java
    severity: ERROR
    message: >-
      A nullable URL value — the 'urlAddress' component field (left null by
      the no-arg constructor chain URL() / ServiceConfigURL() / URLBuilder()),
      the result of a nullable service-info lookup (getServiceInfo() /
      getValidServiceInfo()), or a URL credential local ('username' /
      'password') left null because it was only populated from the inline
      userinfo segment (or the URL body was truncated at '#') — is used
      without a null check. This can throw a NullPointerException. Guard the
      value with a null/empty check (and a parameter fallback for credentials)
      before using it.
    paths:
      exclude:
        - "**/src/test/**"
        - "**/test/**"
    patterns:
      - pattern-either:
          # --- Case c1-4: urlAddress field dereferenced ---
          - patterns:
              - pattern-either:
                  - pattern: |
                      $T $V = urlAddress.$M(...);
                      return $R($V);
                  - pattern: |
                      return urlAddress.$M(...);
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... urlAddress == null ...>) {
                    ...
                  }
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... urlAddress != null ...>) {
                    ...
                  }
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  urlAddress == null ? $A : $B
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  urlAddress != null ? $A : $B
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (...) {
                    ...
                  }
          # --- Case c1-1: service-info lookup result dereferenced ---
          - pattern: getServiceInfo(...).$M(...)
          - pattern: getValidServiceInfo(...).$M(...)
          - patterns:
              - pattern-inside: |
                  $TYPE $SI = $LOOKUP(...);
                  ...
              - metavariable-regex:
                  metavariable: $LOOKUP
                  regex: '(getServiceInfo|getValidServiceInfo)$'
              - pattern: $SI.$M(...)
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... null == $SI ...>) {
                      ...
                  }
                  ...
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... $SI == null ...>) {
                      ...
                  }
                  ...
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... null == $SI ...>) return $X;
                  ...
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... $SI == null ...>) return $X;
                  ...
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... null != $SI ...>) {
                      ...
                  }
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... $SI != null ...>) {
                      ...
                  }
              - pattern-not-inside: 'null == $SI ? $A : $SI.$M(...)'
              - pattern-not-inside: '$SI == null ? $A : $SI.$M(...)'
              - pattern-not-inside: 'null != $SI ? $SI.$M(...) : $A'
              - pattern-not-inside: '$SI != null ? $SI.$M(...) : $A'
          # --- Case c1-3: nullable URL credential used without a null guard ---
          - patterns:
              - pattern-inside: |
                  $T $CRED = null;
                  ...
              - metavariable-regex:
                  metavariable: $CRED
                  regex: '(username|password)'
              - pattern-either:
                  - pattern: new $CTOR(..., $CRED, ...)
                  - pattern: $CRED.$M(...)
                  - pattern: $R(..., $CRED, ...)
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... $CRED == null ...>) {
                    ...
                  }
                  ...
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... null == $CRED ...>) {
                    ...
                  }
                  ...
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... $CRED != null ...>) {
                    ...
                  }
                  ...
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... null != $CRED ...>) {
                    ...
                  }
                  ...
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... isEmpty($CRED) ...>) {
                    ...
                  }
                  ...
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... isNotEmpty($CRED) ...>) {
                    ...
                  }
                  ...
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... StringUtils.isNotEmpty($CRED) ...>) {
                    ...
                  }
                  ...
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... $CRED.isEmpty() ...>) {
                    ...
                  }
                  ...
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... $CRED == null ...>) return $X;
                  ...
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... $CRED != null ...>) return $X;
                  ...
              - pattern-not-inside: 'null == $CRED ? $A : $B'
              - pattern-not-inside: '$CRED == null ? $A : $B'
              - pattern-not-inside: 'null != $CRED ? $A : $B'
              - pattern-not-inside: '$CRED != null ? $A : $B'
commonality: A nullable URL value — the 'urlAddress' component field (left null by the no-arg constructor chain), a nullable service-info lookup result (getServiceInfo()/getValidServiceInfo()), or a URL credential local ('username'/'password') left null by an inline-userinfo-only / '#'-truncated parse — is used without a null guard; guard the value (with a parameter fallback for credentials) before use.
message: A nullable URL value (the urlAddress component field, a getServiceInfo()/getValidServiceInfo() lookup result, or a URL credential 'username'/'password' left null by an inline-only parse) is used without a null check and can throw a NullPointerException. Guard it with a null/empty check (and fall back to the parameter map for credentials) before use.
